title: test(console): spell the record-reach sections sample heading `label`, and read it back (objectui#7321)
body:
Fixes #7321
Clause-②: no

## What and why

The shared declared-input sample in `apps/console/src/__tests__/record-block-record-reach.test.tsx` (`SAMPLE_BY_INPUT.sections`) authored its section heading as `title: 'Main'`. It now spells it `label`, because `label` is the only heading key a `record:details` section entry has:

- **`@objectstack/spec` refuses `title` there.** objectstack#11902 is the spec pin behind that refusal: it declared `defaultCollapsed` / `icon` / `description` on `record:details` sections and deliberately withheld `title` as an alias fork of `label`, pinned by its "still refuses `title`/`headerColor`" case. That is the reason this is `label` and not `title` -- a spec-validity repair, not a typo.
- **The renderer reads `label` alone** since objectui#6190 retired the `s.title ?? s.label` alias limb, and `@object-ui/types` declares a section as `{ name?, label?, columns?, fields }` with no `title`.

The heading string moved into a named constant, `SAMPLE_SECTION_LABEL`, so the new read-back asserts the sample's own string rather than a second copy. Test-only: an empty-frontmatter changeset declares that nothing is released.

## Triage boundaries (triage comment 5548439056)

1. **Load-bearing check, done before the edit.** No assertion in this file or in a sibling console test read the section heading. `SAMPLE_BY_INPUT` is module-local (`git grep SAMPLE_BY_INPUT` hits this file only; the sibling `public-block-binding-reach.test.tsx` has its own sampler). This file's assertions compare record A with record B and with a same-record control, and the heading is the same string on all three mounts, so no verdict moves with it. The base heading was not blank: the red leg below shows the fallback is the section `name`, rendered as `main` in a titled Card. As the dispatch asked, a read-back now pins it. On the `record:details` mount, the rendered DOM must carry a text node equal to `SAMPLE_SECTION_LABEL`.
2. **Sweep of the other shared samples in `apps/console/src/__tests__/`: only this one.** I listed the directory with `git ls-tree origin/main` (34 files, the same count as the working tree) and judged every `title:` hit in it. The sibling probe's `sections` sample already spells `label`. Its `object-master-detail-form` `details` entry spells `title`, which is the canonical key on that surface: the spec's subform entry declares `title` and aliases `label` onto it, and `MasterDetailDetailConfig` declares `title`. The `record:alert`, `page:header` and `page:card` `title` hits are declared inputs. Every other hit is an object field name.
3. objectstack#11902 is cited above as the ground for `label`.

## Red then green for the new pin

The base spelling was restored on the committed head through `ablation-replace.mjs` from the sibling objectstack checkout. It reported anchor hits 1 -> 0 and a changed blob. After the run it restored the file and proved blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. All runs are `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on this one file, under `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- **RED**: `title: SAMPLE_SECTION_LABEL` on `32c4b7b47` gave `Tests  1 failed | 12 passed (13)`. The one failure is `record:details responds to the bound record`: "did not render the sections sample's authored label "Main" as its heading", with the rendered heading span reading `main`.
- **GREEN**: head `32c4b7b47` gave `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  13 passed (13)`. The test file is byte-identical at `a8aded687`.
- **Spec leg**: a one-off check, not committed. `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 `RecordDetailsProps.safeParse` refuses the base sample (`success=false`, `unrecognized_keys` at `sections.0`, keys `["title"]`) and accepts the head sample (`success=true`).

## Local verification at `a8aded687`

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, and the script name `type-check` was echoed. `tsc -p apps/console/tsconfig.json --listFilesOnly` puts the edited test file in the program, with all 34 `__tests__` files in it.

  1. Population: the file resolves under the root `eslint.config.js`. `--print-config` returns 119 rules, and the `**/*.{ts,tsx}` and `**/__tests__/**` blocks apply.
  2. Count: `--format json` reports 1 file, 0 errors and 9 warnings. All 9 are `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`, and the base file gives the same 9.
  3. Invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off. No rule under `eslint-rules/` imports `fs`. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- The touched file already carried cross-file line addresses before this change. The three in the `SAMPLE_BY_INPUT` JSDoc's `RelatedList.tsx` crash note are left as they were. AGENTS.md section 5 rule 11 invites repairing them in a touched file, but the dispatch scope does not cover it, so that is the seat's call.
- The sibling `public-block-binding-reach.test.tsx` cites this file by line range for the sibling `Mount` interface. That citation was already stale on the base, and this diff moves its target further. It is in a different file, outside this card's file surface, so it is noted here and not changed.
